Write the script that runs Atlantis

Source: R/run.R
write_run_script.Rd

Renders the run script template shipped with atlantio (inst/run_scripts/script.sh, the atlantisMerged command line) for the given input files and writes it in the run directory, with the output folder. run_atlantis() runs the script with the run directory as its working directory, so relative paths are relative to it; with Docker, paths must also exist inside the container.

Usage

write_run_script(
  dir,
  init,
  run,
  force,
  physics,
  biology,
  groups,
  fisheries,
  output = "output.nc",
  output_dir = "outputFolder",
  binary = "atlantisMerged",
  file = "run.sh"
)

Arguments

dir

Run directory.

init, run, force, physics, biology, groups, fisheries

Input files: the initial conditions (-i), the run (-r), forcing (-f), physics (-p) and biology (-b) parameter files, the functional groups (-s) and the fisheries (-q).

output

Name of the main output file (-o).

output_dir

Output folder (-d), created in dir if missing.

binary

The Atlantis executable: "atlantisMerged" (found on the PATH when the script runs) or a path to it.

file

Name of the script.

Value

The path to the script, invisibly.

See also

run_atlantis()

Examples

dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(dir)
write_run_script(
  dir,
  init = "init.nc",
  run = "run.prm",
  force = "force.prm",
  physics = "physics.prm",
  biology = "biology.prm",
  groups = "groups.csv",
  fisheries = "fisheries.csv"
)
readLines(file.path(dir, "run.sh"))
#>  [1] "#!/bin/bash"             "set -e"                 
#>  [3] "atlantisMerged \\"       "    -i init.nc 0 \\"    
#>  [5] "    -o output.nc \\"     "    -r run.prm \\"      
#>  [7] "    -f force.prm \\"     "    -p physics.prm \\"  
#>  [9] "    -b biology.prm \\"   "    -s groups.csv \\"   
#> [11] "    -q fisheries.csv \\" "    -d outputFolder"
